from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486302/attempts/db4e56d7e3694d8caea4d8353ff4c479/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-d1090f49.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = one
    dr = (two[0] > r) - (two[0] < r)
    dc = (two[1] > c) - (two[1] < c)
    while abs(two[0] - r) > 1 and abs(two[1] - c) > 1:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(two[0] - r) > 1:
        r += dr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(two[1] - c) > 1:
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
ns={}; exec(compile(source,str(program_path),'exec'),ns)
demo_in=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; demo_in[3][11]=2; demo_in[10][1]=1

for r,c in [(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2)]: demo_expected[r][c]=3
pred=ns['transform'](demo_in)
print('demo match',pred==demo_expected)
test=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; test[1][4]=1; test[13][12]=2
ans=ns['transform'](test)
print(ans)
